acceptance: roadmap-context.md has an 'Outcomes due' section listing Complete nodes whose outcome.check_after has elapsed since completion with no result
The completion date comes from the history index, not a new field
validate warns (never fails) for the same nodes; the digest list is empty when outcome records are absent
nodes.goal: Shipped nodes whose outcome is due but unrecorded are visible where agents and PMs read first.
nodes.title: List shipped nodes with no result after N days

acceptance: roadmap.schema.json allows an optional outcome object: hypothesis, metric (name and source), check_after (ISO duration), status (one of pending, reviewed, waived), observed, learned, decision (one of keep, iterate, kill)
promote copies an idea's hypothesis into outcome.hypothesis; edit-node --set outcome.* sets the fields and only a human changes status to reviewed or waived
The brief shows the hypothesis when present; docs/roadmap-authoring.md documents the fields and the rule that confidential metrics record only a pointer
refresh-schemas delivers the schema change to consumers
nodes.goal: A node can carry the hypothesis it was built on and the human's verdict on what happened, without the CLI reading any metric.
nodes.title: Store a pointer and a human verdict for outcomes, never the metric itself
